---
title: "Install RStudio Instructions"
---

## Step 1: Install R

RStudio runs on top of R, so install R first.

- Go to [https://cran.rstudio.com/](https://cran.rstudio.com/).
- At the top of the page, select the download for your operating system:
    - **macOS** — click the latest `R-x.y.z.pkg` installer. Download and run it.
    - **Windows** — click **base**, then **Download R for Windows**. Download and run the installer.

## Step 2: Install RStudio

Once R is installed, install RStudio.

- Go to [https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/).
- Scroll to **All Installers and Tarballs** and pick the version for your operating system. The site will usually recommend the right one at the top.
- Download and run the installer.

RStudio is a set of integrated tools for working in R: a console, a syntax-highlighting editor that supports direct code execution, and tools for plotting, debugging, and managing your workspace.
